term: meaningful: independent predicate, one-way condition, full calibration or proposal membership
resolution: The existing one-way principle is necessary-only and is not a full definition. These new independent propositions calibrate V1/V2/V3 or all-in-scope to the independent predicate on an explicit scope. Existing StrongVerificationismWithLaws and Ayer1946ExcludesANegation already retain full biconditionals and are preserved. All-admitted fails an explicitly supplied exclusion goal, not every possible meaning account. Named coverage remains open; its additional-extension rival denies coverage under exactly this extensional profile. V4 expressive membership/pragmatic adoption is a different question (DISAMB-V4-PROPOSAL-MEANING-AND-TRUTH), not a fifth interchangeable cognitive-meaning predicate. See docs/notes/meaning-definition-fork.md.
